personality_one_liner: A calm, modest, and trustworthy utility that provides peace of mind, feeling more like a caring insurance assistant than a noisy tech product.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical whitespace and comfortable reading rhythms. Avoid dense dashboard aesthetics. Use generous padding for touch targets (minimum 44x44, oversized for Activate).

do's: Use for sticky bottom 'Activate' action containers
Use for bottom tab bar and modal headers
Use for floating Action Buttons or bottom sheet handles
dont's: Never use on form fields or basic list rows
Avoid heavy blur that makes text unreadable

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Google sign-in and optional biometric lock.
screens.layout: Hero graphic with a calm off-white/blue abstract background. Large, easy-to-read welcome text. Primary button for Google Sign-in at the bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard listing handoff profiles and a prominent Activate Handoff button.

states.empty: Calm illustration of a safe space, text prompting to create the first profile.
states.error: Error message with a retry button

screens.layout: Welcome greeting at the top. List of flat, pale profile cards (Pet, Home, etc.). A sticky, oversized 'Activate Handoff' primary button anchored at the bottom using brandPrimary color.

screens.name: ProfileDetail
screens.purpose: Add or edit a specific handoff profile type with care instructions and photos.
screens.layout: Single-column form. Labels above inputs. Clean, separated sections for instructions and photo upload. Sticky 'Save Profile' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: TrustedContacts
screens.purpose: Manage trusted contacts and their notification priority.

states.empty: Illustration of a handshake/connection, prompting to add a trusted contact.
states.error: Error fetching contacts with retry action.

screens.layout: List of contacts with avatar (initials or photo). Priority ordering indicated gently. Floating Action Button or sticky bottom CTA to add a new contact.

screens.name: ActivationFlow
screens.purpose: Confirm activation, show countdown to undo, and display active status.

states.error: Failed to activate warning with retry.

screens.layout: Bottom sheet confirming activation. Once confirmed, full-screen countdown (large typography). Then transitions to Active Event screen showing notified contacts.

screens.name: ShareView
screens.purpose: Read-only view for trusted contacts accessed via link.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for the shared information

screens.layout: Clean, web-like reading experience. Generous line-height, large text, clear section dividers. No complex navigation, pure utility.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage account, privacy, data deletion, and subscriptions.
screens.layout: List of settings options with tinted Phosphor icons. Clear, separated section for Subscription Tier UI with mocked upgrade. 'Sign Out' and 'Delete Data' clearly marked.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow 1 iOS-Native Clean layout principles: generous padding, readable text, calm and non-intrusive elements.

Implement the custom color palette strictly. Use 'brandPrimary' (#2C63A0) exclusively for the oversized Activate button and major CTAs to make them stand out against the calm 'brand' and 'surface' colors.
Ensure the base font size is larger than default (16pt base) to meet accessibility and legibility goals for stressful moments.
Do not use color alone to convey status; always pair with an icon and text (e.g., success green + check icon + 'Delivered').
The 'Activate' button on the Home screen must be sticky at the bottom and significantly larger (e.g., min height 56-64pt) than standard buttons.
Avoid any flashy or gamified elements. The app must feel like a quiet, trustworthy insurance or health assistant.
Support Dynamic Type and reduced motion where applicable (e.g., minimal bouncing, prefer simple crossfades or slide-ups).
Use Phosphor icons with consistent weight (preferably outlined or filled consistently per screen) and simple rounded shapes.
For avatars, use real photos when available; fallback to initials inside a solid 'brandTertiary' background container.
Apply 'expo-glass-effect' for the sticky Activate container background to ensure it stands out while maintaining the calm aesthetic, if it scrolls over content.
